body.name: Non-oracle support-cleaned nuisance-rate handle
body.construction: Use \(\mathfrak F\) as follows.  On \(\mathcal M^{\beta}_{K,\varepsilon}(B_{\mathrm H})\), fit one raw tensor-product B-spline product likelihood for \((\pi,M_A,M_Z,f)\) with \(s_n\asymp n^{(d_X+1)/(2\beta+d_X+1)}\).  Choose from the \(K!\) common permutations the maximizer of the empirical training-sample minimum diagonal-minus-largest-off-diagonal self-report probability.  Apply the support-cleaning map to the two raw measurement matrices, enforce the cleaned half-margin inequalities in the coherent-fit definition, set \(\tau_G=\varepsilon/2\), and derive \(w,W,B,d,D,R,N,h,G,b_{(\cdot)},b_U\), \(\widehat G_{\tau_G}^{\dagger}\), and \(\widehat Q\) from that single cleaned product law.  Choose \(\tau_{S,n}\) without true-support information.  The handle does not take a true support, the true \(G\), or a true rank as an input; design-known zeros may be imposed only when supplied as observed design information.
